question: Should OpenClaw accept timeout-produced native compaction results during the bounded safety-wrapper acceptance window, or require a replacement design that never commits after timeout cancellation?
rationale: The patch appears correct and well-tested, but green tests do not decide the session-state policy of committing a compaction result after timeout cancellation has fired.

options.title: Accept bounded timeout commits
options.body: Merge this shape if maintainers agree that a WeakSet-backed timeout reason may permit a cooperative compaction result to commit before the safety wrapper rejects.

options.title: Require a different state policy
options.body: Pause or close this branch if maintainers want progress preservation without allowing any post-timeout cancellation commit window.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded timeout commits
recommendation.body: Merge this shape if maintainers agree that a WeakSet-backed timeout reason may permit a cooperative compaction result to commit before the safety wrapper rejects.
